meta.name: map-codebase
meta.description: Deep architecture report that fans out parallel inspections across different aspects of the codebase (structure, tech stack, APIs, patterns, data flow, dependencies, testing) and synthesizes findings into a comprehensive document at .turbo/codebase-map.md and .turbo/codebase-map.html. Use when the user asks to "map the codebase", "map codebase", "architecture report", "codebase overview", "architecture overview", "what am I looking at", or "explain this codebase".
